name: military-registry
description: Git hooks and checks for the whole repository (backend and frontend have their own package.json)

scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
